title: Tire Pressure Warnings and Pressure-Test Mentions
summary: Feedback in this topic mixes clear complaints about tire-pressure monitoring, warnings, and display usability with unrelated or procedural mentions of pressure testing and no-loss findings.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe tire-pressure monitoring malfunctions, early tire-pressure issues, a puncture-related low-pressure warning, and frustration that pressure information is not shown in the instrument cluster or head-up display.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention cooling-system pressure tests, a finding of no pressure loss, and a comment that updates should be more thoroughly pressure tested, without a clear sentiment about the vehicle itself.

limitations: The cluster mixes tire-pressure complaints with unrelated cooling-system and software-testing uses of the word pressure.
Several examples are terse service-style notes, so the customer impact and sentiment are not always clear.
The sampled fragments are stratified examples and are not representative estimates of broader vehicle performance.
